description: Execute Python code to process data

data_input.info: Upstream data, accessible via data_input variable in script

script.info:
Write Python code to process data

[Available Variables]
• data_input - List of Data objects from upstream
• result - Set this variable as output (required)

[Output Methods]
Assign processed result to result variable:
• Dict: result = {'key': 'value'}
• List: result = [item1, item2]
• String: result = 'output text'
• Data object: result = Data(data={...})

[Debug Output]
Use print() for debug messages. After execution, view complete logs in node status including:
• Start time and duration
• Standard output (print content)
• Error output (if any)
• Execution status

[Example Code]
if data_input:
    # data_input is a list of Data objects
    items = [item.data for item in data_input]
    result = {'count': len(items), 'data': items}
else:
    result = {'message': 'No input data'}
script.default_code:
# Access upstream data
if data_input:
    # data_input is a list of Data objects
    print(f'Received {len(data_input)} items')
    
    # Extract data content
    items = [item.data for item in data_input]
    
    # Process data
    processed_count = len(items)
    print(f'Processing complete, {processed_count} items')
    
    # Set output result
    result = {
        'count': processed_count,
        'data': items
    }
else:
    print('No input data received')
    result = {'message': 'No input data'}
